focus: 站會三件事：狀態、卡點、請求
lead: 今天練的是用結構撐住一段 stand-up：開場先宣告你要講幾件事，中間用狀態燈快速交代，結尾一定要留下一個帶日期的請求。重點不是講得多，而是讓人聽完知道「接下來誰要做什麼」。每個 speaking 段落請先出聲講完再看 model answer。

phrases.en: Three things from me, then I'll hand back.
phrases.gl: 我有三件事，講完就交還（先宣告長度，聽的人立刻放鬆）
phrases.ex: Three things from me, then I'll hand back: labeling throughput, the retrain, and one ask on GPU time.

phrases.gl: 先給數字（比任何形容詞都快讓人抓到狀況）
phrases.ex: Numbers first: 18k of the 30k frames came back from the vendor, so we're at 60% of the batch.

phrases.en: Green on A, amber on B.
phrases.gl: 用狀態燈交代多條線，一句話涵蓋全局
phrases.ex: Green on the urban set, amber on the tunnel runs — GNSS coverage drops out for about 400 metres.

phrases.en: The one thing slowing us down is…
phrases.gl: 單點指出瓶頸（比列一堆問題有力得多）
phrases.ex: The one thing slowing us down is GPU contention — the retrain is queued behind two other teams.

phrases.en: I'm waiting on X from Y, and I'll chase it today.
phrases.gl: 我在等誰的什麼，而且我今天會去追（不是抱怨，是有主導權）
phrases.ex: I'm waiting on the revised extrinsics from the calibration team, and I'll chase it today.

phrases.en: Best case…, worst case…, and I'm planning for…
phrases.gl: 給時程區間再說你押哪一個（誠實又有立場）
phrases.ex: Best case the retrain finishes Wednesday, worst case Friday, and I'm planning for Thursday.

phrases.gl: 沒進度就乾脆講一句（不要為了填空硬擠內容）
phrases.ex: Rear fisheye calibration — no change from Friday, still waiting on the vendor bracket.
phrases.fix: 取代 "Still same, no special update, everything is going"

phrases.en: That's still an estimate — I'll firm it up by Wednesday.
phrases.gl: 標記這是估計值，並承諾何時給準的（把不確定變成可管理）
phrases.ex: Two weeks for the re-collection — that's still an estimate, and I'll firm it up by Wednesday.
phrases.fix: 取代 "I'm not sure, maybe around two weeks, it depends"

phrases.en: One ask before I hand back:
phrases.gl: 收尾丟出唯一的請求（讓 stand-up 真的產生行動）
phrases.ex: One ask before I hand back: I need two hours of dedicated GPU time on Tuesday night.

setup: Setup. Monday stand-up for the ADAS data platform sprint. The labeling vendor returned 18k of the 30k frames you sent two weeks ago, and the rest are queued behind another program. Your detector retrain has been sitting in the shared GPU queue since Saturday because two other teams booked the cluster. Over the weekend the team also found that the tunnel collection runs lose GNSS fix for roughly 400 metres, so those bags can't be auto-aligned to the map. David, the program manager, runs the stand-up and times it. Alan, the perception tech lead, is on the call and tends to pull the conversation into implementation detail.

prompts.q: David: “Momo, you're up. Keep it under a minute.”
prompts.frame: Announce how many items → numbers first → status per line → one ask.
prompts.say: 先出聲講完整段（目標 45 秒），開場就宣告你要講幾件事。
prompts.model: “Three things from me, then I'll hand back. Numbers first: 18k of the 30k frames came back from the labeling vendor over the weekend, so we're at 60% of that batch. Green on the urban set — it's labeled and ingested. Amber on the retrain: it's been queued on the shared cluster since Saturday behind two other teams, so nothing has actually run yet. And we picked up a new one over the weekend — the tunnel runs lose GNSS fix for about 400 metres, so those bags can't auto-align to the map. Ivy is checking whether we can bridge it with the IMU. One ask before I hand back: I need two hours of dedicated GPU time Tuesday night, otherwise the retrain slides into next week.”

prompts.q: David: “When do I get a number on the tunnel data — is it recoverable or not?”
prompts.frame: Say what you know today → separate the two possible outcomes → give a range with the date you'll firm it up.
prompts.say: 出聲練習「還沒有答案，但聽起來仍然在掌控中」，禁止用 “I'm not sure” 開場。
prompts.model: “I can't give you a clean yes or no yet, but here's where it sits. If the IMU drift stays under a couple of metres over that stretch, we bridge the gap in post-processing and lose nothing — that's the good case. If it doesn't, we re-collect the tunnel scenarios, and that's roughly four collection slots. So best case we keep everything, worst case we re-collect about two weeks of tunnel data, and I'm planning for something in between. That's still an estimate — Ivy is running the drift check today and I'll firm it up by Wednesday stand-up.”

prompts.q: Alan starts walking the room through IMU integration drift and Kalman filter tuning. You're 40 seconds in and the stand-up is running long. Redirect and close.
prompts.frame: Credit the point → put it somewhere specific with a time → restate your one ask → close cleanly.
prompts.say: 出聲練習「把時間收回來」——要禮貌，但不要道歉。
prompts.model: “That's exactly the right question, and I don't want to answer it badly in thirty seconds — can you and Ivy take fifteen minutes right after this and come back to us Wednesday with a recommendation? I'll put it on the agenda. So from me: labeling at 60%, retrain blocked on cluster time, tunnel data under investigation. The one thing I need is two hours of GPU on Tuesday night. That's me — back to you, David.”

fixes.bad: Vendor returned 18k frame last week, still 12k in queue.
fixes.good: The vendor returned 18k frames last week, and 12k are still in the queue.
fixes.note: Articles + plurals：vendor、queue 前面要 the；frame 可數，18k 要用 frames。中文沒有單複數，這是最容易被聽出來的一個習慣。

fixes.bad: We will finish the calibration in next Monday.
fixes.good: We'll finish the calibration by next Monday.
fixes.note: Preposition：next Monday 前面不加 in（也不加 on）；而且進度承諾用 by（在那之前完成）比 on（剛好那天）更安全也更專業。

fixes.bad: I want to update you my status about the retrain.
fixes.note: Preposition + register：update 的搭配是 update someone on something。而且 stand-up 不需要先宣告「我要報告了」，直接進入內容更俐落。

fixes.bad: I already send the request to hardware team last Thursday but no reply until now.
fixes.good: I sent the request to the hardware team last Thursday and haven't heard back.
fixes.note: Tense：有明確過去時間點（last Thursday）就要用過去式 sent；「到現在都還沒」用現在完成式 haven't heard back，不要說 until now。

fixes.bad: The progress is a little bit slow, we will try to speed up this week.
fixes.good: We're about three days behind. I'm adding a second labeling shift to pull one of those back.
fixes.note: Vagueness：a little bit slow 和 try to speed up 都沒有給任何可追蹤的東西。落後就講幾天，補救就講具體動作 —— 這是 PM 和「回報者」的差別。

challenge:
今天在真實 stand-up 中做這一件事：用宣告結構開場，用一個請求收尾 ——

“___ things from me, then I'll hand back. Numbers first: ___. Green on ___, amber on ___. One ask before I hand back: I need ___ by ___.”

錄音作業（60 秒，手機錄）：用英文講一次你這週真實的進度，嚴格控制在 60 秒內。

  • 開場十個字以內要出現「我有幾件事」
  • 前 15 秒必須出現一個數字或比例
  • 其中一條線如果真的沒進度，就直接說 “No change from Friday.”，不要硬掰
  • 結尾必須是一個帶對象和日期的請求
  • 禁用：a little bit slow、I'm not sure、try to speed up、until now
check: 我開場有沒有先宣告「我要講幾件事」，讓對方知道會佔用多久？
前 15 秒之內我有沒有講出至少一個數字，而不是只有形容詞？
我的 stand-up 結尾是一個帶對象和日期的請求，還是就這樣講完沒了？
